subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the permanent fix preserve paragraph separators in-band on chunks now, or require explicit boundary metadata before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the durable boundary contract affects shared block-streaming semantics and two open PRs already propose overlapping text-based repairs.

options.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
options.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require chunker reconstruction plus coalescer no-double-separator coverage, and close the other PR as superseded after a viable path is chosen.

options.title: Require boundary metadata first
options.body: Pause the text-based PRs until paragraph, newline, and hard-split metadata is designed through chunking, coalescing, and delivery.

options.title: Keep open for redesign
options.body: Reject the current text-preservation direction and leave the issue open for a maintainer-sponsored streaming boundary redesign.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
recommendation.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require chunker reconstruction plus coalescer no-double-separator coverage, and close the other PR as superseded after a viable path is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and later refined the paragraph block-streaming behavior that defines the current boundary contract.
